case.lyrics:
[Verse]
You have a question, I wanna know
No need to rush it, let the question flow
[Chorus]
What is your question? Send it my way
I brought a whole band for one thing to say
Yeah, yeah, what do you say?

caption: laid-back reggae, offbeat muted guitar, warm rounded electric bass, live one-drop drums, organ replies. adult male singer. Melodic reggae singing: short syncopated phrases, offbeat pickups, laid-back timing, clipped endings, restrained vibrato, space for band replies. Natural vocal recording, no robotic effects, no speech narration. Resolved ending.
